opening.argument: The speaker addresses people who have invested in Bitcoin mining with BitClub Network and points to the facility behind him as the operation connected to that investment. He identifies it as “the mining facility owned by BitClub Network” and claims, “We have 10,000 machines right behind me.” The visible Bitmain machines reinforce the presentation of working mining equipment as evidence of that affiliation. By inviting viewers to visit the facility and see the operation for themselves, the speaker supports the paid mining arrangement through the displayed site and equipment, while making no claim beyond the stated mining-investment connection.
